learning_outcomes.text: Knows the basic properties of three-phase thyristor converters, their characteristics under all operating conditions, and their impact on the power system.
Knows the properties and characteristics of complex thyristor converter systems and thyristor power regulators. Knows the topologies of basic tracking systems for reactive power compensation.
Has knowledge of DC/DC pulsed converters and single and three-phase autonomous voltage inverters. Knows the principles of scalar and vector PWM modulation used in two-level inverters.
Has the ability to analyze the operation of complex power electronic systems and select their parameters for specific operating conditions.

syllabus_topics: Laboratory classes: converter-based, reversible DC drive without circulating current
power electronic systems for improving electric energy quality
soft start systems for induction motors
Single and three-phase thyristor converter (rectifier and inverter operation, commutation, impact on the supply line, external characteristics, limitations in inverter operation, protection).
Bidirectional converters with and without circulating current.
Single and three-phase AC thyristor switches (thyristor power regulators), their control properties for RL, R, L loads and impact on the supply line.
Pulsed DC/DC systems for buck and boost voltage; current waveform of the power source supplying the pulsed converter, input filters.
Single and three-phase voltage inverters with PWM modulation.
Principles of vector PWM modulation used in voltage inverters.
Current inverters with PWM modulation. Rectifier operation of an autonomous inverter.
Pulsed power supplies with a unity power factor.
Examples of applications of power electronic systems.
assessment_rules: Lectures are verified by examination. Laboratory classes are verified by examination. Students are required to prepare for laboratory exercises, which may be verified by an oral or written colloquium. Passing the laboratory module is possible after passing all laboratory classes.
